exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of Hepatopulmonary fusion (HPF) and right-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) via fetal ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
cohort: One patient diagnosed prenatally with hepatopulmonary fusion (HPF) associated with right-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH).
finding: Prenatal recognition of hepatopulmonary fusion (HPF) associated with right-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) allows for comprehensive preoperative planning, leading to successful surgical intervention and improved patient outcomes.
